about.title: Decades of centrifugal work in Houston.
text: Chiller Services, Inc. has been a commercial and industrial HVAC contractor out of Pasadena since 1987, specializing in HVAC sales, service and installation.
The company has years of experience and some of the best centrifugal mechanics in the business, and many of Houston's largest building owners and property managers have depended on it for decades.

On the industrial side the company is not tied to a specific brand. Off the shelf equipment from the major manufacturers, a custom modification or a complete custom build are all available, and the choice is whatever is right for the job.
